d: The Rockets defeated the Clippers, 116-104 tonight in Houston. Kevin Durant contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 9 rebounds 4 assists and 4 three pointers, with Alperen Sengun of the Rockets adding an additional 20 points (7-11 FG, 1-2 3P) in the game. Darius Garland finished with a team-high 26 points along with 8 assists for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 13-5 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 4-12 for the season.
